title: The carved front door
caption: Daksina Bhawan, from the street.
note: You know it is the right place before you read the sign: a carved wooden porch with a warm glow behind the doors.
alt: The front of Daksina Bhawan South Indian Restaurant: a gabled porch with a tiled roof and teal scalloped trim over the name sign, a carved wooden frieze with three round medallions above a pair of wooden doors with glowing glass panels, carved peacocks on the pillars either side, tall potted palms, a white wrought-iron chair and table on green turf, and a standing sign with a painted dancer's face, on a wet brick pavement

title: Under the temple bells
caption: Brass temple bells hang over the dining room.
note: Look up first. The bells are the first thing you notice here.
alt: A narrow dining room with a dark wooden ceiling hung with rows of brass temple bells, a carved wooden staircase on the left, an arched mural of a South Indian temple tower with palms and an elephant at the far end, and cushioned booths along a panelled wall

title: A dosa, folded in half
caption: A crisp dosa, with sambar and chutneys.
note: It arrived golden and folded like a half moon. The dosa is why I keep going back.
alt: A crisp golden dosa folded in half on a round hammered steel plate, with small steel bowls of sambar and red, white and green chutneys beside it, seen from above on a dark wooden table

title: The temple on the wall
caption: A temple painted on the wall, under a ceiling of bells.
note: The mural is the quiet centre of the room.
alt: A tall arched wall mural of a colourful South Indian temple tower beside banana and coconut palms, a lotus pond in front and an elephant with a rider at the right, with brass bells hanging from a wooden grid ceiling above and booths below

title: Blinds over the murals
caption: Soft murals behind half-drawn blinds.
note: Painted scenes glow behind the blinds. A quiet corner of the room.
alt: Two woven reddish blinds half drawn over backlit sepia murals of palms, riverside temple steps and a tree, with a brass lantern between them, and cane-backed wooden chairs and tables with menus below

title: Lanterns on a panelled wall
caption: Brass lanterns on a panelled wall.
note: Small lanterns, dark wooden frames and carved squares: the details are everywhere in this room.
alt: A tall cream wall with dark wood moulded panels, a row of glowing brass lanterns, carved wooden squares set on the diagonal, and a wooden slatted ceiling above, with booths and tables at the bottom

title: Up the wooden stairs
caption: The wooden staircase under the bells.
note: Carved posts and a polished handrail. Even the stairs look like they belong to an old house.
alt: A carved wooden staircase with turned balusters and carved posts climbing to a small upper level under a ceiling of hanging brass bells, with part of the temple mural and a wall lamp at the right

title: The house on the hill
caption: A tiny hill with one house lit from inside.
note: Someone built a whole hillside and then left a light on in one little house.
alt: A hand-made miniature hill in greens, teal and rust, with a small timber house with a red roof and softly glowing windows, and a thin curved road winding round it; plants and a black planter stand behind it on a desk

title: Signed on the back
caption: The back of the hill, signed by the artist.
note: Turn it over and it tells you who made it: Aslam Khan, 19/7/26.
alt: A hand holding the back of a small wooden panel, dark and textured with pale crusted growth, with a white paper label reading Aslam Khan 19/7/26 in one corner and handwriting along the bottom edge

title: A lamp over the pothos
caption: One small lamp, one pothos, and everything else in the dark.
note: With the room light off, a corner turns into a stage. The lamp pours yellow-green over the leaves, and even the brown edges look deliberate.
alt: A pothos plant lit from above by a small white lamp in a pitch-black room, its heart-shaped leaves glowing yellow-green with a few brown patches

title: Under the blossom ceiling
caption: Under a ceiling of pink blossom.
note: The first thing you do here is look up. The whole ceiling is blossom.
alt: A restaurant dining room under a thick ceiling of pink blossom, with red leather booths, gold lattice screens and a lit bar at the back

title: Two glasses, one dim table
caption: Two drinks at a dim table.
note: One glass was all chocolate swirls, the other glowed like a lamp.
alt: Two tall glasses with paper straws on white napkins: a creamy drink streaked with chocolate and an amber iced drink, in warm dim light

title: Soup, sauces and something crisp
caption: Soup, sauces and something crisp, in low sun.
note: The light came in sideways across the table and turned everything copper.
alt: A dark table from above: two black bowls of orange soup with coriander and cherry tomatoes on a P.F. Chang's napkin, a tray of three chilli sauces, and a long dish of crisp glazed batons with peas

title: Spring rolls, cut open
caption: Spring rolls, cut open.
note: Cut on the slant so you can see the filling before you dip.
alt: Four crisp spring rolls cut in half on a square black plate, with a small black bowl of dark chilli dipping sauce beside them

title: Noodles with a crown of crispy garlic
caption: Noodles under a crown of crispy garlic.
note: The crunch on top is the whole point.
alt: A black bowl of stir-fried noodles with green beans, carrot and cabbage, covered in golden crispy garlic, with a serving spoon and fork resting in it

title: Twirled and glazed
caption: Twirled and glazed.
note: The plate looks like a night sky, and the noodles are the only warm thing on it.
alt: A swirl of golden noodles with sticky glazed pieces and spring onion on a dark speckled stone plate, with another plate blurred behind

title: A fortune, half out
caption: A fortune cookie, with the fortune half out.
note: Dinner ends with a tiny prophecy.
alt: A hand holding a cracked fortune cookie with a small paper slip showing, in a dim restaurant with a blurred table and diner behind

title: Durga Maa, for Navratri
caption: Durga Maa, lit up for Navratri.
note: A pandal in the middle of the mall, put up for Navratri. Durga Maa stands tall in white and gold, with her family around her.
alt: A large white idol of the goddess Durga with many raised arms, standing on a lion above a buffalo, with four smaller figures around her including Ganesha, in front of a white lace-like arch and between two golden patterned screens, on a round stage ringed with light behind red rope barriers and potted plants, in a mall atrium

title: Flowers at the crossing
caption: Orchids and chrysanthemums in the middle of the mall.
note: Pink orchids rising out of a ring of potted plants, and a polished floor that doubles everything.
alt: A round table with a twisting rose-gold base holding tall white vases of pink orchids, green and magenta chrysanthemums, ringed by black pots of variegated green plants on a polished marble floor, with shop fronts and hanging festive decorations in the mall behind

title: A wall of mural and mirrors
caption: The coffee mural wall at Costa.
note: The wall does all the talking: a big coffee mural and tall oval mirrors with a warm halo behind them.
alt: A long café wall of cream plaster under a terracotta ceiling with black track lights and round white globe lamps, holding a large framed mural in red and orange, two tall oval mirrors edged with yellow light, wooden chairs with plum seats, a brown leather bench and a planter of green leaves, with a tray of red Costa cups on a table at the right

title: Coffee, from bean to cup
caption: Coffee, drawn from bean to cup.
note: Up close, the mural tells the whole story of coffee, from blossom to roaster to cup.
alt: A close view of a framed wall mural in red, pink and orange showing a coffee plant with a white blossom and berries, a large circle of coffee beans, a roasting machine with a small seated figure holding a cup, and curling steam, beside a round white lamp under a terracotta ceiling

title: Serene caramel frappe
caption: The serene caramel frappe, held up against the mural.
note: Costa's signature serene caramel frappe. The coffee is great.
alt: A hand holding a tall red and pale blue paper cup marked COLD COFFEE, topped with whipped cream and caramel under a clear dome lid, in front of a colourful coffee mural and a brown leather booth

title: A slice of cheesecake
caption: A slice of cheesecake.
note: Smooth, creamy and simple. The cheesecake is good too.
alt: A triangular slice of plain baked cheesecake with a pale golden top and a biscuit crumb base, on a gold cake board on a beige tray

title: A camera, a cup and an old newspaper
caption: An illustrated camera and cup at NY United Cafe.
note: Seen at NY United Cafe, on the ground floor of my office. It looks like a morning from another decade.
alt: An illustration seen from above of a pale green and maroon film camera on a folded newspaper, a white cup of amber drink on a saucer, and a small instant photograph, on a blue wooden table with chipped orange paint

title: A heart in the foam
caption: A painted latte with a heart in the foam.
note: Another one from NY United Cafe, downstairs at my office: thick, bright brushstrokes and a small heart in the foam.
alt: A thickly painted picture of a cup of coffee on a saucer with a heart in the foam and steam rising, against swirling brushstrokes of orange, gold and deep blue

title: The emptiest metro
caption: A Delhi Metro platform, almost empty, the day the gates were shut.
note: 10 October 2026. Entry and exit gates were closed at 45 stations for a protest in central Delhi, and the platforms emptied. I was on my way from Delhi to Gurugram, and it was the first time I had seen a Delhi metro station this empty.
alt: A long, almost empty Delhi Metro platform under a slatted wooden ceiling, with closed glass platform doors on the right, a steel pillar wrapped in a line map and a sign reading Platform 1 towards Botanical Garden, a floor striped in pink and green with yellow tactile paving, and one passenger sitting on a round bench at the left edge

title: Two figures in charcoal
caption: A charcoal drawing by my friend Dr. Nishant.
note: My friend Dr. Nishant is a psychologist and an artist at heart. I took this photo when we met in Delhi.
alt: A charcoal drawing on bright pink paper of two figures in a close embrace seen from behind, one with dark curly hair, signed with a bold N at the lower right, in a spiral-bound sketchbook held up by a hand in a dimly lit room

title: Samosa chaat, in a paper bowl
caption: The samosa chaat at NY United Cafe.
note: It is so tasty. This is the café on the ground floor of my office, where my usual order is the walking taco and chai.
alt: A hand holding a white paper bowl of samosa chaat with a wooden spoon: pieces of samosa and chickpeas under curd, red sauce, chopped onion, coriander and a heap of fine sev, with a menu board showing burgers and omelettes behind

title: Love is in the air
caption: A heart in the clouds above my office.
note: 28 September 2026. The weather turned beautiful out of nowhere, and then a heart appeared in the sky above my office. It looked so romantic. Love is in the air, quite literally.
alt: A heart-shaped patch of dark blue cloud among white and grey clouds, above the glass towers of an office park with an Urbana sign, over a plaza with potted trees, hoardings and a few people walking

title: The one thing between me and my six pecs
caption: Chole bhature with sweet lassi, from Pind Bhaturas.
note: I love chole bhature so much that I order them every Sunday. I cannot say no to them at all. This one is from Pind Bhaturas in Gurugram, where I always order from, and it is so good, so tastyyyy. The one thing standing between me and my six pecs.
alt: A round steel plate seen from above with two golden puffed bhature, a glass bowl of dark chole with a spoon, a black bowl of sliced onions and peppers, a small tub of green chutney, and a hand holding a tall bottle of sweet lassi, on a grey blanket

title: Batman, on guard at my desk
caption: My crocheted Batman, on duty.
note: My sister gave me this wool Batman when I was on a trip in Jaipur. I have always been a huge Batman fan, and she knows it. Now he stays with me at the office, on my desk, all the time.
alt: A small crocheted Batman doll in a dark cowl with white eyes, a pale yellow face, a grey body and a yellow belt, standing on the keyboard of an open laptop whose screen shows a Batman lock-screen wallpaper with a red bat symbol and the time 17:18

title: Veni, vidi, vici
caption: Caesar's three words, tattooed.
note: My recent tattoo: veni, vidi, vici, the famous line from Julius Caesar. It means "I came, I saw, I conquered." I am trying to bring that line into my life, conquering and achieving everything I long for.
alt: A pencil-shaded close-up of the side of a person's neck below the ear, with a small tattoo of the words VENI written downwards and VIDI and VICI written across it, forming a cross with leaf-tipped arrows at each end

title: The verandah, after dark
caption: Shikarbagh, lit up after dark.
note: Fairy lights all along the verandah. The ambience at Shikarbagh is so good, especially at night.
alt: A long verandah at night under a cream canopy printed with small elephants, its edge covered in green vines strung with fairy lights, with lanterns glowing by wooden glass doors and large yellow planters along a stone-paved walkway

title: Lanterns in the garden
caption: The garden seating at Shikarbagh.
note: The garden at night, under strings of lights.
alt: A gravel garden dining area at night with strings of round bulbs overhead, green lanterns glowing with a warm flame light along a wooden slatted fence, black metal chairs and tables, a few people standing in the distance and tall trees behind

title: The fountain, in absolute dark
caption: Taken in absolute dark, thanks to my iPhone 17 Pro.
note: It looks lit from every side, but it was taken in absolute dark. Thanks, iPhone 17 Pro.
alt: A tiered cream stone fountain in a round pool edged with blue mosaic tiles, a thin jet of water rising through the leaves of a large tree, with cream tent canopies, a gravel yard and a glowing lamp behind, all looking brightly lit although the scene was almost completely dark

title: Dinner under the canopy
caption: The tented dining area at Shikarbagh.
note: A tented dining area, busy with an evening crowd.
alt: A tented dining area at night with a ceiling printed with gold elephants and palm trees, wall fans and lanterns on pale green posts, people eating at wooden tables, and a green ice bucket on a dark wooden cabinet in the foreground

title: The courtyard fountain
caption: A fountain in the courtyard, after dark.
note: Shikarbagh is inside Hotel Narain Niwas Palace in Rambagh, Jaipur. It is also where I met my bhabhi in person for the first time.
alt: A cobbled courtyard at night with a lit fountain in a round pool, a warmly lit palace building with arched windows behind it, low pavilions with strings of lamps on either side, parked cars, a palm tree and two people standing by the fountain

title: Creamy pasta and garlic bread
caption: Pasta and garlic bread at Shikarbagh.
note: We ordered so much food and drinks here, and all of it was so good.
alt: A wide white bowl of creamy penne with broccoli and chopped herbs, with a slice of toasted garlic bread on the rim and a dark spoon, on a dimly lit table with an empty plate behind

title: Peach and lemon mocktail
caption: The peach and lemon mocktail.
note: The drinks were good too: a peach and lemon mocktail.
alt: A hand with a black-strapped watch holding a tall glass of orange-pink mocktail with two paper straws, on a dimly lit restaurant table with a plate and glasses behind

title: Peach iced tea and cold coffee
caption: Peach iced tea and cold coffee at Punjab Grill.
note: A peach iced tea and a cold coffee at Punjab Grill, DLF Cyberhub.
alt: Two tall glasses on a wooden table: a peach iced tea with a thick pale foam and a paper straw in front, and a cold coffee dusted with brown powder behind it, with a hand holding a phone out of focus above

title: Malai chaap, on a stand
caption: Malai chaap at Punjab Grill.
note: Malai chaap, served hanging off a stand at Punjab Grill.
alt: Pieces of grilled malai chaap on two skewers hanging from a metal stand over a cast-iron tray of charred peppers, with a drizzle of white cream sauce, and a tall cold coffee behind

title: KitKat's own F1 car
caption: KitKat's Formula 1 car, in KitKat red.
note: KitKat showed off this F1 car, built around their own brand, and it looks so cool. The banner behind it says KitKat is an official partner of Formula 1.
alt: A bright red Formula 1 style car on a display stage, with the KitKat logo and the words Have a break along its nose and sides, in front of a backdrop of a race track and a red banner reading Official Partner of Formula 1, with rope barriers and staff in red shirts at the left

title: A fancy dinner
caption: Dinner at Skyhouse Bar & Kitchen.
note: A fancy dinner after the movies, on a good day at my cousin's in Noida. The food is a 4.5.
alt: A baked dish with a browned, cheesy top and vegetables in a dark restaurant, with a knife and fork resting on its edge

title: Drinks with a cherry on top
caption: Drinks at Skyhouse.
note: Skyhouse is so good, and so is the ambience.
alt: A stemmed glass of pale orange drink with a cherry on a pick and a fan of sliced apple, next to a bright orange drink with a lime garnish and a red drink behind, in a dim bar with warm lights

title: Inside Skyhouse
caption: Inside Skyhouse Bar & Kitchen.
alt: The ceiling and bar of a dark venue: beams and ducts lit blue, clusters of glowing glass cubes hanging at the left, two small Indian flags above a black espresso machine, and shelves of bottles lit amber at the right, over a wooden panel with a warm strip of light
note: A good day, and Skyhouse was a big part of it. The ambience is great and the food is also good.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
caption: On the big screen.
note: We went to watch movies after a day at my cousin's in Noida, and this title lit up the screen.
alt: The Marvel Studios title card for Spider-Man: Brand New Day glowing in red, blue and yellow on a dark cinema screen, tilted in the frame

title: The langur that wasn't
caption: A langur that turned out to be a cutout.
note: A langur, some way off, that never moved. I zoomed in with my phone, and it was a kind of scarecrow. We all laughed so much.
alt: What looks at first like a grey langur sitting upright in front of a yellow-framed wire mesh, next to a large tree trunk; it is actually a cutout scarecrow, photographed zoomed in

title: Brutality
caption: Sub-Zero wins, flawlessly.
note: Me at home on the PS5, playing Mortal Kombat and hitting a brutality.
alt: A blurred PS5 controller in the foreground and a wall-mounted TV behind it showing the Mortal Kombat Brutality screen, with Sub-Zero holding two ice axes and the words Sub-Zero wins

title: Golden clouds
caption: A sky of golden clouds.
alt: A sunset sky with a golden-lit cumulus tower rising from a bank of peach clouds at the bottom, under long streaks of grey and blue cloud
note: The low sun lit the cloud tops gold while the rest of the sky stayed grey and blue. Light like this only lasts a few minutes.

title: The moon through the clouds
caption: The moon, glowing through a patch of clouds.
alt: The moon as a bright disc behind thin clouds that glow peach and pale rainbow colours against dark blue clouds, with the silhouettes of tree branches at the right and bottom
note: The soft peach and rainbow colours in the thin cloud around the moon come from light bending around tiny water droplets, which is called cloud iridescence.

title: The Parvati, early
caption: The Parvati river, early in the morning.
note: The valley road follows the Parvati river up to Kasol, which sits at about 1,580 m in Kullu district.
alt: A wide view of the Parvati river rushing over a stony bed in a green valley, with a few wooden houses on the far hillside and steep, sunlit mountains behind, framed by trees on the right

title: Roses and pines
caption: Roses, with the pine forest behind.
alt: Two red roses in the foreground, in focus, with a pine forest and rocky ridge in soft focus behind and a clear blue sky above
note: The forests around Kasol are mostly pine. The town is in Kullu district, at about 1,580 m.

title: Sitting with the river
caption: Evening on the rocks by the Parvati.
alt: A person in a green shirt and black cap sitting on a pale boulder in the middle of a fast mountain river, looking away to the side, with a pine-covered slope behind
note: The Parvati is fed by snowmelt and joins the Beas at Bhuntar, where the Kasol road leaves the main highway.

title: Arms out
caption: Standing on the biggest boulder in the river.
alt: A person in a pale green shirt standing on a large grey boulder in a river, arms stretched out to the sides, with a pine-covered hillside behind and a soft, grainy, faded colour grade
note: In the river by the camp. This photo has no time, so it is placed by its position in the camera's numbering.

title: A stack of stones
caption: A small cairn on the riverbank.
alt: A stack of smooth river stones balanced on a boulder, with the Parvati river rushing past out of focus and a pine forest on the hillside behind
note: On the riverbank at the camp, taken at about 6 pm on 17 May.

title: Among the pines
caption: The pine forest by the river, in the last light.
alt: Tall pine trunks with rough red-brown bark in the foreground of a forest clearing, a carpet of pine needles underfoot, golden light on a mountainside and a stone-built guesthouse among the trees on the right
note: Taken at about 6 pm on 17 May, on the same stretch of the Parvati as the camp.

title: Down the valley
caption: Looking down the valley between the pines.
alt: A clearing among tall pines with a steep mountain slope on the left and a gap between the trees showing the valley opening into hazy golden light in the distance, and the river just visible below at the left
note: From Bhuntar the road runs about 30 km up the Parvati valley to Kasol. It is narrow, so it is best driven in daylight.

title: The bike, the river, the sun
caption: A Royal Enfield, with the sun going down over the valley.
alt: A cream and black Royal Enfield motorcycle parked on a sandy riverbank in the foreground, with a wide braided river, a few people walking on the stones, a dark pine forest and the sun flaring over a mountain ridge in the background
note: At Koshla, just north of Manali, at 5:29 pm on 18 May. The phone logged about 1,926 m.

title: A roadside stop at dusk
caption: Leaning on the crash barrier, with the mountains behind.
alt: A smiling person in a black top, jeans and a checked scarf leaning on a yellow and black crash barrier at the roadside, with a forested mountain slope and a thin waterfall behind in a hazy, grainy blue-green grade
note: In Solang Valley, about 9 km north of Koshla. This photo has no time, so it is placed by its position in the camera's numbering.

title: A bottle on the table
caption: A bottle of Jägermeister, on the trip.
alt: A hand holding up a large bottle of Jägermeister, label facing the camera, in a wood-panelled room with a pink chair and tables blurred behind
note: Taken at the same spot as the flag photo, just north of the Atal Tunnel, a few km before Sissu.

title: Shiva, at the temple
caption: A statue of Shiva in front of the temple spire.
note: Manikaran is a pilgrimage town for Hindus and Sikhs: a Shiva temple stands next to the Manikaran Sahib gurdwara, and the hot springs run at 64 to 80 °C.
alt: A dark relief statue of Shiva with matted hair, rudraksha beads and a cobra, holding a long trident with a damaru, set against a stone wall in front of a tiled temple spire, with a pink flower and coins left at the base

title: Flags over the gorge
caption: Strings of coloured flags across the Parvati gorge.
alt: Lines of small coloured flags strung high across a narrow river gorge between a white multi-storey building with a Santpura sign on the left and an arched, weathered building on the right, with green mountains and a rocky stream below
note: Manikaran is 3.5 km further up the Parvati valley from Kasol.

title: Manikaran, on the Parvati
caption: Manikaran, stacked up the side of the gorge.
note: The hot springs here sit within the Manikaran Sahib gurdwara and the nearby Shiva temple, and locals cook food in the water.
alt: The town of Manikaran climbing the left bank of the Parvati river, its guesthouses stacked on the hillside above a temple with a railing, with the river tumbling over boulders in the centre and orange-stained water running down the retaining wall at the bottom left

title: Divine vibes in Manikaran
caption: Divine vibes in Manikaran.
alt: A person in a black cap and black top at an ornate white railing, one hand on their head and their face hidden behind the other, with rows of coloured flags overhead, mountains behind and the text DIVINE VIBES IN MANIKARAN with an Om symbol across the sky
note: At about 1:25 pm on 18 May, in Manikaran, about 1,670 m up by the phone.

title: The tricolour at Sissu
caption: The Indian flag against the snow peaks of Lahaul.
note: Sissu sits at about 3,120 m on the Chandra river, just north of the Atal Tunnel.
alt: The Indian flag flying from a pole on a dry mountainside, with snow-streaked mountains rising behind it and a deep blue sky full of white clouds above

title: The Sissu waterfall
caption: The waterfall at Sissu, still fed by the snow.
note: The fall drops about 50 m and sits across the Chandra river from the village.
alt: A thin white waterfall dropping down a dark cliff face into a spray-filled gorge, with tongues of snow and green scrub on the slopes above and bright green meadow either side of the base, where tiny figures stand

title: Prayer flags over Jispa
caption: Prayer flags over Karma Cottage & Camp in Jispa.
note: Jispa is a village on the Bhaga river at about 3,200 m, a favourite overnight stop on the Manali–Leh highway.
alt: Lines of tattered prayer flags in blue, white, red, green and yellow crossing a bright blue sky above red-roofed cottages, an orange restaurant and a Karma Cottage & Camp, Jispa sign, with snow-topped peaks and a steep brown mountain behind

title: Last light on the peaks
caption: The last of the sun on the mountains above Jispa.
alt: A dark triangular mountain in shadow with the ridge behind it lit orange by the setting sun, snow in the gullies and white clouds drifting over a deep blue sky
note: Jispa was the night stop. This one was taken a few km further north, near Darcha, on the way back down from the Shinku La road.

title: Blue hour in Jispa
caption: Blue hour over the rooftops of Jispa.
alt: A jagged snow-covered peak wrapped in cloud with a pink glow on its summit, above the rooftops of a few concrete and tin-roofed guesthouses in the cool blue light after sunset

title: Morning in Jispa
caption: Morning light on the mountain above Jispa.
alt: A huge slanted rock face of layered grey and rust stone under a clear blue sky, with snowy peaks behind it, a pale riverbed and meadow in the foreground

title: Snow peaks, on the way up

note: The phone's altimeter read about 4,030 m here, roughly 20 km north of Jispa (in a straight line).

title: A seat on the guardrail

place: On the road to Shinku La
note: About 4,190 m by the phone's altimeter. Above 4,000 m it is worth going slowly and drinking plenty of water.

title: Snowing on the Shinku La road
caption: Snow falling at the top of the road.

place: On the road to Shinku La

title: Morning in the valley
caption: The Parvati valley, early on 17 May.

title: At the camp
caption: Outside the tent we stayed in at Kasol.

title: Rapids

title: The hot spring

title: Mirror selfie
caption: A mirror selfie in the room in Ujjain.

title: In the cream shirt
